stem_book: A locomotive of mass m starts moving so that its velocity varies according to the law v = k√s where k is constant and s is the distance covered. Find the total work performed by all the forces which are acting on the locomotive during the first t seconds after the beginning of motion. (a) W = (1/8)mk⁴t² (b) W = (1/4)m²k⁴t² (c) W = (1/4)mk⁴t⁴ (d) W = (1/8)mk⁴t⁴
work: a = v dv/ds = k²/2 → v = k²t/2; W = ΔKE = (1/2)m(k²t/2)² = mk⁴t²/8
